abilities.name: Sweeping Fervor
abilities.caveat: Shown at its lowest strength, from hitting 0–1 opponents; hitting 2 or 3+ opponents gives progressively stronger shields that aren't reflected. Not modeled: the top tier's periodic Pyro DMG, and the shield's extra effectiveness against Pyro DMG.
_curatorNotes: Shield effect authored 2026-07-12 at Level 1 (Ad Lib), the unconditional floor granted regardless of opponents hit (gcsim skill.go: updateShield(1) queued at skillShieldStart=28f when no XinyanSkill shield exists; c.shieldLevel defaults to 1 in xinyan.go). TL10 values: scaling 187.3% DEF + 1101 flat (sidecar 'Shield Level 1 DMG Absorption' 10th col '187.3% DEF+1101'; gcsim xinyan_gen.go shieldLevel1[9]=1.87272, shieldLevel1Flat[9]=1101.2996). DEF snapshotted at cast (snap.Stats.TotalDEF()). target 'active': gcsim shield.go Target=-1 = party shield protecting the on-field character (Thoma/Diona precedent). durationType 'refresh': recast replaces the shield and refreshes 12s (12*60f in updateShield; summon terminatesOn recast).

Shield LEVEL is gated on the number of OPPONENTS HIT, not team composition. gcsim skill.go increments hitOpponents per enemy in the attack callback: hitOpponents >= shieldLevel2Requirement (default 2) → Level 2, >= shieldLevel3Requirement (default 3) → Level 3; A1 (asc.go a1) lowers each requirement by 1. Higher-tier TL10 values NOT authored (no enemyCount Condition primitive; planner has no enemy-count model) — surfaced via caveat only. Level 2 (Lead-In): 220.3% DEF + 1296 (shieldLevel2[9]=2.2032, shieldLevel2Flat[9]=1295.6465). Level 3 (Rave): 259.2% DEF + 1524 (shieldLevel3[9]=2.592, shieldLevel3Flat[9]=1524.29). NOT modeled via teamElementCount(pyro): that condition counts Pyro allies, an unrelated mechanic — see orchestrator flag.

Level 3 shield (Rave) deals Pyro DoT every 2s (120f) to nearby opponents while the Level-3 shield holds (gcsim skill.go shieldDot, 2*60f re-queue; DoT mult TL10 60.5% ATK, skillDot[9]). Not modeled — no schema field for a DoT attached to a shield entity, and it only exists at the unmodeled Level 3 tier. Surfaced in caveat.

C2 constellation also creates a Level 3 shield at burstShieldStart=43f of burst animation (gcsim: burst.go, c.Base.Cons >= 2 branch). Not modeled in burst summons[]. Reviewer to check C2 effects entry.
[A7] Caveat tier names dropped for length: Level 1 Ad Lib (0–1 opponents hit), Level 2 Lead-In (2 opponents), Level 3 Rave (3+ opponents).

[A7] A1 ascension passive lowers the Level 2 / Level 3 opponent thresholds to 1 and 2; it is already surfaced as its own passive panel entry, so it was dropped from the skill caveat to avoid duplication.
[A7] Pyro absorption effectiveness is 2.5x (250% DMG Absorption vs Pyro per skill description); exact multiplier demoted, qualitative 'extra effectiveness against Pyro' claim retained.

↻ 2026-08-14 — the stand-in summon is retired. "Shield" was a zero-effect `summons[]` entry whose only jobs were to give this instant cast a 12s active window and to put a labelled bar on the chart. Both now have their own field: `activeDuration` on the ability and `label` on the shield Effect, which the shield lane renders. `summons[]` is back to meaning a thing left in the world. Bar geometry is unchanged apart from the spawn offset, which the shield window never had.
abilities.description:
Xinyan brandishes her instrument, dealing Pyro DMG on nearby opponents, forming a shield made out of her audience's passion.
The shield's DMG Absorption scales based on Xinyan's DEF and on the number of opponents hit.
·Hitting 0–1 opponents grants Shield Level 1: Ad Lib.
·Hitting 2 opponents grants Shield Level 2: Lead-In.
·Hitting 3 or more opponents grants Shield Level 3: Rave, which will also deal intermittent Pyro DMG to nearby opponents.

The shield has the following special properties:
·When unleashed, it infuses Xinyan with Pyro.
·It has 250% DMG Absorption effectiveness against Pyro DMG.

constellations.name: Rockin' in a Flaming World
_curatorNotes: 2026-05-11 (queue item 4): authored via existing-schema DEF→ATK pattern. `stat: 'atk', value: { type: 'scaling', stat: 'def', ratio: 50 }` expresses '+50% of DEF as flat ATK'. Trigger=passive (always-on while Cons:6) — renders as chip in TeamBonusesBlock.

Fidelity caveats: (1) the in-game text scopes the ATK bonus to Charged Attacks only ('Xinyan's Charged Attacks gain an ATK Bonus equal to 50% of her DEF'); the schema doesn't support ATK-stat-scoped-to-CA, so this over-renders against ALL Xinyan damage (same caveat as Yanfei C1 / Eula C4 in their respective domains). (2) The 30% stamina reduction on CA is not modeled (out of scope — stamina isn't in the planner). (3) gcsim does NOT implement C6 (function body commented out in cons.go), so this authoring is based on in-game description only.
constellations.description: Decreases the Stamina Consumption of Xinyan's Charged Attacks by 30%. Additionally, Xinyan's Charged Attacks gain an ATK Bonus equal to 50% of her DEF.
